svg.aria-label: One loader element: One loader element puts a launcher on the page. The widget app runs in an isolated iframe. Desktop and mobile: Floating button on desktop, bottom sheet on mobile. Studio settings: Position, theme and language come from studio settings. Signed-in users only: Logged-out visitors see a sign-in prompt
